items.label: Document parsing on
items.description: Let plugins read text out of uploaded files.
items.long_description: When off, ocr::parse refuses. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Largest file parsed (MB)
items.description: Files larger than this are not parsed.
items.long_description: From 1 to 100. Uploads themselves are limited to 25 MB. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Most pages read per file
items.description: Pages after this many are ignored and the result says so.
items.long_description: From 1 to 1000. The engine's own setting (bridge.liteparse.max_pages) can only lower it further.

items.label: Most text kept per file (KB)
items.description: Longer text is cut and the result is marked truncated.

items.label: Seconds a plugin waits for a parse
items.description: A file that takes longer is refused for a direct call.
items.long_description: From 1 to 9: a plugin call is cut off after ten seconds, so this cannot be higher.

items.label: Parses running at once
items.description: More are made to wait, then told the reader is busy.
items.long_description: From 1 to 8. Each parse can use a lot of memory; raise it only on a machine with room.

items.label: Parsing engine
items.long_description: liteparse is the only engine so far.

items.label: Most parses waiting or running
items.description: More are refused until some finish.
items.long_description: From 1 to 1000. Protects the job queue when many files are submitted at once.
